segments.text: The buyer requested a supplier for a repair order. Finance checked the bank details and the purchasing manager approved activation. I activated the supplier.
Finance called the supplier using the published switchboard number and compared the bank details during that call.
The callback result was saved in the supplier record and the purchasing manager recorded approval in the workflow.
I changed the status from on hold to active. The buyer then placed the repair order.
I do not know what the exception process is. I have only handled the normal route.
